headline: The gold reason code is right under the documented 'highest tier' rule, but the Tier-2 code 'unconfirmed_external_communication' names this exact situation (a mailed flyer), so the two codes overlap.

issues.summary: Two transfer-reason descriptions both fit a customer who holds a flyer for an offer the KB doesn't have, keeps pushing after repeated refusals, and then demands a human. The gold Tier-1 code wins only through the tier-priority sentence.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042: "Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies."

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 (TIER 1): "customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal | Customer asked about offers/promotions that don't exist in the system, you informed them the offers aren't available, customer persisted multiple times, and now demands human"

doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042 (TIER 2): "unconfirmed_external_communication | Customer claims a specific promotion/program/offer exists (they have a letter, email, or flyer) but you cannot verify or find it in the KB after searching"
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that matches on the flyer wording picks the Tier-2 code and fails ACTION grading. The tier rule settles the choice, so a careful agent reaches the gold. In the earlier Opus trials 3 of 4 picked unconfirmed_external_communication.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the two rows mutually exclusive, e.g. add 'and the customer has not repeatedly persisted after refusal' to the Tier-2 row, or put a worked example in doc 042.

solution_check: None of the three flyer offers exists as stated. The KB has no $1,000-for-$10k personal offer (the closest, Business Bronze, gives $500 and is business-only), no 3-year $0-FTF promo, and Platinum's first-year fee waiver ran 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31 and has expired. The agent refuses each one; after 8 refusals the customer demands a human. Tier 1 'customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal' applies, and the highest-tier rule puts it ahead of Tier 2, which matches gold[0].
prior_note: Same Minor reason-code overlap as the prior review, still settled by the documented highest-tier rule. Sibling task_014 hits the same overlap from the other direction (its gold is the Tier-2 code).
notes: ACTION-only grading. The Platinum fee-waiver promo (platinum_009) shows that offer #3 exists in the KB but has expired, which still counts as 'unavailable'. doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_009's 'Do not transfer' rule covers referral-link requests only, so it does not apply here.
